Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 57 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Enhanced Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Typhoon EMONG
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 24 July 2025(Thursday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Cavite, Batangas and Laguna.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Metro Manila and Rizal.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija and Quezon which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

An orange rainfall warning remains in effect over Zambales, Bataan, Cavite, Batangas and Laguna as of 5 p.m. Thursday, July 24, due to the enhanced southwest monsoon and Typhoon #EmongPH.

Meanwhile, a yellow rainfall warning was still raised over Metro Manila, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan and Rizal with possible flooding in flood-prone areas, according to PAG-ASA.
